name: Citigroup
description: Citigroup is a global bank that earns from lending and deposit spreads, card interest and fees, and fees and trading gains from serving multinational companies. It reports five segments: Services (treasury and trade solutions, and securities services custody and fund administration for institutions), Markets (fixed income and equity trading), Banking (investment banking, corporate lending), Wealth (Private Bank, Citigold, Wealth at Work) and US Personal Banking (branded cards, retail services cards, retail banking). Its 2025 earnings are still held down by Banamex (Mexico) and other divestitures, which are booked in All Other: Citi sold 25 percent of Banamex on 2025-12-15 and plans an IPO of the rest. Net revenues were $85.2B and net income $14.3B in 2025.

employees.note: Approximately 226,000 full-time employees (229,000 a year earlier) in over 90 countries.

businessLines.name: Services
businessLines.how: Institutional clients pay fees and interest spread for moving money and trade finance (Treasury and Trade Solutions, 15,378 computed) and for custody and fund administration (Securities Services, 5,878), mostly recurring, tied to balances and transaction volumes.

operatingProfit.period: FY2025 (year ended 2025-12-31), segment income from continuing operations

businessLines.name: Markets
businessLines.how: Trading and financing for institutional clients: earns bid-offer spreads, trading gains and financing interest in fixed income and equity markets; revenue moves with client activity and volatility.

operatingProfit.period: FY2025 (year ended 2025-12-31), segment income from continuing operations

businessLines.name: Banking
businessLines.how: Corporate and investment banking: fees for advising on and underwriting deals (investment banking fees $4,618M in 2025) and interest on corporate loans; fee revenue is deal-driven and lumpy.

operatingProfit.period: FY2025 (year ended 2025-12-31), segment income from continuing operations

businessLines.name: Wealth
businessLines.how: Wealth clients pay advisory and management fees on assets, plus net interest on deposits and loans, across Private Bank, Citigold and Wealth at Work.

operatingProfit.period: FY2025 (year ended 2025-12-31), segment income from continuing operations

businessLines.name: US Personal Banking (USPB)
businessLines.how: Consumers pay interest on card balances and fees on Citi-branded and retail-partner (private label) credit cards, plus retail banking spread; card revenue depends on balances and credit losses.

operatingProfit.period: FY2025 (year ended 2025-12-31), segment income from continuing operations

businessLines.name: All Other (managed basis) and divestiture-related items
businessLines.how: Residual corporate and treasury items plus businesses being divested (Banamex in Mexico, AO Citibank in Russia); a goodwill impairment of $726M ($714M after tax) was taken on the Banamex 25 percent sale agreement.

revenue.period: FY2025 (year ended 2025-12-31), All Other 4,430 plus reconciling items (176)

brands.name: Citigold / Private Bank / Wealth at Work
Banamex (Grupo Financiero Banamex, Mexico)
brands.note: 25 percent sold 2025-12-15 to a company owned by Fernando Chico Pardo and family; remaining stake planned for IPO and further private sales; Citi recognises 75 percent of net income and 25 percent to noncontrolling interests

whatsNext.text: Banamex: IPO of the remaining stake and any additional private sales, subject to market conditions and regulatory approvals (no date given)
